reason: Final refit used an empty validation set, but fit_model called estimator.predict on that empty matrix. scikit-learn rejected the zero-sample input, causing BAYC DINOv2 OLS to fail after tuning completed.
changes: Skip validation prediction when z_valid has zero rows for PLS, LinearSVR, and other estimator families.
Start resumed progress counting at zero so checkpoint traversal does not double-count existing fits.
Include attempted configurations and statuses in future final-refit failure messages.
